title: Sunday · Beverly Beach, again
logline: Beverly Beach in August, where the sand dollar came from in May: the cliffs, the surf, the tide pools, the dog at thirteen in the shallows. The strip's second visit; the sand dollar's home.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a different beach: high sandstone cliffs, a wide surf, tide pools at their foot, August light.

image.prompt: a beach beneath high sandstone cliffs with wide surf and tide pools at their foot in August light, no words

panels.name: Cliffs

panels.composition: Tier 2: a tide pool, close: anemones, a sand dollar half buried, the dog's reflection over it.

image.prompt: a tide pool with anemones and a half-buried sand dollar and an old dog's reflection on its surface, no words

panels.name: Pool

panels.composition: Tier 3: the old dog standing in the shallows, a man behind on the sand, the cliffs. Held.

image.prompt: an old dog standing in shallow surf with a thin man behind on the sand beneath sandstone cliffs, no words

panels.name: Shallows

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The sand dollar's beach. The dog in the shallows at thirteen.
